title: 日付、すべての日、失われた日付の区切り
html:
06 Dates 治世のすべての日と、失われた日付の区切り

入力: 05_months_and_records/out/records.jsonl と暦 (cjk-calendar、humanities-skills)。出力: out/dated.jsonl、out/calendar_days.csv、out/shuo_check.csv、out/dividers.csv、out/empty_days.csv。コード: run.py（ロジックは lib/dating.py）。確認: check_days.py。

日付付け

暦は、各月の最初の日と最後の日をユリウス通日 (JDN) で与えます。干支をもつ記事は、その月の中でその干支をもつ1日です。干支のない記事は、その前の記事と同じ日になります。是歲と是年には、年の精度を与えます。編年体の記録は前にしか進みません。そのため、各月で、戻ることのない日の最長の連なりを残します。

その連なりの外にある、または月のどの日でもない、記号の後の干支（59件）は、規則で決めます（著者の裁定、2026-11-10）。（最初は59件でした。そのうち2件は、ページがスキャンで順序を誤ったものであることがわかり、ステップ03で直しました。）

  • 読み誤った日 (46): 両側にある日付つきの記事の間の空の日のうち、ちょうど1日が、読み取った形と1文字だけ違っています。丁卯、次に戊戌、次に己巳なら、その日は戊辰です。その日を採用し、ganzhi_as_read に読み取った形を残し、注記に「corrected by the calendar」と書きます。古いデータベースには、この46日のうち28日に記事があります。
  • 日付ではない (11): 合う日が1つもありません（己未科…、または2文字とも誤読）。その記事は、前の記事の日を保ちます。フラグは残します。

これらはすべて、その後でページ画像と照合しました: flagged_check_2026-11-10.md。

確認 A: 朔

見出しの1日の干支を暦と比べます。218中216が一致しました。違う2つは OCR の読み誤りです（丙午を丙子、辛丑を辛卯）。レビューのために一覧にしてあります。

確認 B: 空の日と、失われた日付の区切り

治世は6,526日（221月）です。そのすべてが out/calendar_days.csv にあり、各日の記事数がつきます。記事のない日は誤りではありません。しかし、自分の日を書いた2つの記事の間では、その間のすべての日が空です。その空の日の干支が、そこにある記事の中に書かれていれば、日付の区切りが失われています。
記事のある日、前 4,665
復元した日付の区切り（下の3つの規則を見てください） 395
記事のある日、後 5,108（うち46は直した干支から）
確実でないためレビューに送った日付の区切り 3
まだ空の日 1,418: 1,361は本文に何もない、54はフラグつきの干支の横、3はレビュー中

次の3つのうち1つが確実にするとき、日付の区切りを復元します。

  1. 干支の前に空白がある（失われた記号が隙間を残した）: 343件。ほとんどは、日が上昇する連なりの中にもあります。
  2. そのような日が2つ以上、上昇する順で続いている。

  3. 連続する日（著者の規則、2026-11-10）。干支の前に空白がない場合:

    • 前の日付つきの記事の直後の日で、かつ次の記事の直前の日でもあるため、1日の穴を埋める: 32件。
    • 前の日付つきの記事の直後の日で、その後の日が空である: 10件。
    • 次の日付つきの記事の直前の日（または次の月の1日の直前）で、その前の日が空である: 10件。

    両側に空の日がある干支は、レビューに回します（3件。そのうち1つ、上以戊申紀元は、日ではなく年です）。

復元した日付の区切りの多くは、OCR が丸印を空白として書いたページから来ています。juan 135 の1つの「記事」には23日分がありました。

古いデータベースとの確認 (check_days.py)

自分の干支をもつ記事のある日: 私たちは5,108、古いデータベースは5,014、両方にあるのは4,770です。復元した395日のうち、古いデータベースにあるのは346です（規則3の52日のうち43）。提案した3つのうちでは2つです。

結果

13,550記事。13,549に日付がある (99.99%)。自分の日があるものが5,116、引き継いだものが8,419、年の精度のものが14です。フラグつきは279です（日付として採用しなかった干支が11。残りは後から書かれた記事と、形の似た読み誤りです）。

うまくいかなかった点

  • 最初の順序の確認は、各日をそれまでで最も遅い日と比べました。月の後半の1つの干支の読み誤りで、163の正しい日が間違いに見えました。最長の連なりの規則にすると、22が残ります。
  • 30日ずれた朔の読み誤りが、「月の近く」として受け入れられました。

印のついた 干支 を、ページ画像と照合

フラグつきの13の「日付ではない」記事を1つずつ調べた (2026-11-10)

それぞれを、日の表（その前後の日付つきの記事と、その間の空の日）と照らし、さらにページ画像と照らして調べました。「ページ」はスキャンのページ (01_render/out/seq-NNNN.png) です。

これが示すこと

  • 2件は最初から正しかったのです。スキャンで3ページの順序が違っていました。欄外に印刷されたページ番号がそれを証明していて、ステップ03は今、本全体についてそれを確認します（これが唯一の場所です）。
  • 1件は、2文字とも読み誤った実際の日でした。ページから訂正しました。
  • 6件は日付ではまったくありません。OCR が他の言葉を、干支のようなものに変えました（命成、昏刻、內閣、茂陵、虜入、以上）。「日付ではない」という規則は正しかったのですが、それらの記事のテキストは間違っていて、校正が必要です。
  • 1件は、記事がすでにもっている日と同じ、実際の日です。
  • 3件は鈔本自体にあります。写しで日の順序が乱れていて、古いテキストも同じ読みです。これは OCR ではなく校勘記への問いです。フラグを残し、その前の記事の日を保ちます。

コード

run.py 171 行
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 06. Give every record a date, lay the records beside every day of the reign,
and use the days with no record to find lost dividers.

In:   05_months_and_records/out/records.jsonl
      the calendar: lib/reign_calendar.py (cjk-calendar database, humanities-skills)
Out:  out/dated.jsonl        every record with jdn, Gregorian date, lunar day, precision,
                             where the date came from, and flags
      out/calendar_days.csv  EVERY day of the reign, with its 干支 and the number of
                             records on it
      out/shuo_check.csv     every month header: the 朔 in the text vs the calendar's
      out/dividers.csv       every lost divider found: restored (certain) or left
                             for a person (proposed)
      out/empty_days.csv     every day that still has no record, and what the text shows
      out/report.json
The logic is in lib/dating.py (step 08 uses it again after the review).

Dating rules
  1. The month comes from step 05.  The calendar gives its first and last day as
     Julian Day Numbers (JDN).
  2. A record with a 干支 is that day: the one day in the month (looking two days
     either side, because the Shilu's calendar and the tables can differ by a day)
     with this 干支.  A month has at most 30 days and a 干支 returns every 60, so
     there is never more than one.
  3. A record without a 干支 is on the same day as the record before it.
  4. 是月: precision `month` (filed on the last day of the month).  是歲 / 是年:
     precision `year`.  先是: same day as before, flagged `retrospective`.
  5. The chronicle only moves forward.  In each month we keep the longest run of
     days that never goes back.  A 干支 after a mark that falls outside that run,
     or that is no day of the month, is one of two things:
       - a misread day: exactly one empty day between the dated records on either
         side differs from it by one character (丁卯, 戊戌, 己巳: the day is 戊辰).
         That day is taken; the reading is kept and the correction is noted.
       - otherwise not a date (己未科…): the record keeps the day of the record
         before it, and the flag stays.
     (The first version compared each day with the latest day so far.  One misread
     干支 late in the month then made every true day after it look wrong.)
  6. A 干支 obtained only by correcting a look-alike character (王子 for 壬子) is
     dropped as "not a date" when it fails these tests.

Check A: the 朔.  The header names the 干支 of the first day.  The date was computed
from era, year and month only, so this is a test against a value we did not use.

Check B: empty days, and lost dividers.  All days of the reign are laid beside
the records.  A day with no record is not an error in itself.  But between two
records that carry their own day, A then B, every day in between is empty; if the
text of the records in that stretch contains the 干支 of one of those days, a
divider was probably lost there (the OCR missed the circle, or the copyist did).
  - certain: the 干支 follows a blank; or two or more such days follow in rising
    order; or the 干支 is the day right after the previous dated record's day, or
    the day right before the next one's (one side is enough; the other side may
    be empty days).  The record is cut there and the new record is dated.  `restored`
  - otherwise: listed for a person in step 07.  `proposed`
The pass is repeated until nothing new is found.

Run:  uv run 06_dates/run.py
"""
import collections
import csv
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE / "lib"))
import dating  # noqa: E402
import ganzhi  # noqa: E402
import manifest  # noqa: E402
import reign_calendar  # noqa: E402

RECORDS = BASE / "05_months_and_records" / "out" / "records.jsonl"
OUT = HERE / "out"


def main() -> None:
    months = reign_calendar.months()
    mkey = dating.month_index(months)
    records = [json.loads(l) for l in open(RECORDS, encoding="utf-8")]
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    n, shuo_rows = dating.date_records(records, months)
    before = {"records": len(records),
              "days_with_records": len({r["jdn"] for r in records if r["precision"] == "day"})}
    restored, passes = [], 0
    while True:
        found = dating.find_lost_dividers(records, months)
        certain = [c for c in found if c["certain"]]
        if not certain or passes == 5:
            break
        passes += 1
        restored += [{**c, "pass": passes} for c in certain]
        records = dating.apply_cuts(records, certain)
        n, shuo_rows = dating.date_records(records, months)
    proposed = [c for c in found if not c["certain"]]

    # every day of the reign
    on_day = collections.Counter(r["jdn"] for r in records if r["precision"] == "day")
    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in records:
        if r.get("month") is not None:
            groups[mkey[(r["era"], r["year"], r["month"], r["leap"])]].append(r)
    prop_day = {c["jdn"]: c for c in proposed}
    day_rows, empty_rows = [], []
    e = collections.Counter()
    for i, M in enumerate(months):
        recs = groups.get(i, [])
        for d in range(M["first_jdn"], M["last_jdn"] + 1):
            gz, cnt = ganzhi.of_jdn(d), on_day.get(d, 0)
            day_rows.append([d, reign_calendar.gregorian(d), M["era"], M["year"], M["month"], M["leap"],
                             d - M["first_jdn"] + 1, gz, cnt])
            if cnt:
                continue
            finding, where, context = "nothing in the text", "", ""
            if d in prop_day:
                c = prop_day[d]
                finding, where, context = "干支 inside a record, not certain: for review", c["rid"], c["context"]
            else:
                later = next((k for k, r in enumerate(recs) if r["precision"] == "day" and r["jdn"] > d), len(recs))
                k0 = later - 1
                while k0 > 0 and recs[k0]["date_from"] not in ("own", "header", "restored"):
                    k0 -= 1
                near = [r for r in recs[max(k0, 0):later + 1] if "干支" in r["flags"] or "not taken" in r["flags"]]
                if near:
                    finding, where = "a flagged 干支 sits here: possibly this day, misread", near[0]["rid"]
                    context = near[0]["gz_as_read"] + " | " + near[0]["flags"]
            e[finding.split(":")[0]] += 1
            empty_rows.append([d, reign_calendar.gregorian(d),
                               f"{M['era']}{M['year']}年{'閏' if M['leap'] else ''}{M['month']}月",
                               d - M["first_jdn"] + 1, gz, finding, where, context])

    with open(OUT / "dated.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def write(name, head, rows):
        with open(OUT / name, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            w = csv.writer(f)
            w.writerow(head)
            w.writerows(rows)

    write("calendar_days.csv", ["jdn", "gregorian", "era", "year", "month", "leap", "lunar_day", "ganzhi", "records"], day_rows)
    write("shuo_check.csv", ["rid", "juan", "header_as_read", "ganzhi_as_read", "ganzhi", "calendar_first_day", "agree", "note"], shuo_rows)
    write("empty_days.csv", ["jdn", "gregorian", "lunar_month", "lunar_day", "ganzhi", "finding", "record", "context"], empty_rows)
    write("dividers.csv", ["status", "pass", "rid", "pos", "ganzhi", "jdn", "gregorian", "why", "context"],
          [["restored", c["pass"], c["rid"], c["pos"], c["ganzhi"], c["jdn"], c["gregorian"], c["why"], c["context"]] for c in restored] +
          [["proposed", "", c["rid"], c["pos"], c["ganzhi"], c["jdn"], c["gregorian"], c["why"], c["context"]] for c in proposed])

    dated = sum(1 for r in records if r["jdn"] is not None)
    numbers = {"records_in": before["records"], "records_out": len(records),
               "records_dated": dated, "share_dated": round(dated / len(records), 4),
               "months": len(months), "days_in_reign": len(day_rows),
               "days_with_records_before_restoring": before["days_with_records"],
               "days_with_records": len(day_rows) - len(empty_rows),
               "dividers_restored": len(restored), "restore_passes": passes,
               "dividers_proposed_for_review": len(proposed),
               "empty_days": len(empty_rows), "empty_days_by_finding": dict(e), **dict(n),
               # counted from the notes: a later pass sees the corrected 干支 as an ordinary one
               "ganzhi_corrected_by_calendar": sum(1 for r in records if "corrected by the calendar" in r["notes"])}
    (OUT / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(numbers, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    manifest.write(HERE, [RECORDS], [OUT / f for f in ("dated.jsonl", "calendar_days.csv", "shuo_check.csv",
                                                      "dividers.csv", "empty_days.csv", "report.json")], numbers)
    print(json.dumps(numbers, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Dating records against the calendar, and finding lost dividers.  Used by steps 06 and 08.

date_records(records, months)   -> numbers, shuo rows.   Adds jdn, gregorian, lunar_day,
                                   precision, date_from, flags to every record.
find_lost_dividers(records, months) -> proposals: a 干支 written inside a record that
                                   names a day in the empty gap after that record.
apply_cuts(records, cuts)       -> new list of records with those records split.
"""
import collections
import re

import ganzhi
import reign_calendar

SLACK = 2                     # days either side of the month (Shilu vs. table differences)
NOT_A_DAY_AFTER = "日年科歲朔"  # 甲子年, 甲子科, 甲寅日 (narrated), …
GZ = re.compile(ganzhi.STEMS.join("[]") + ganzhi.BRANCHES.join("[]"))


def month_index(months):
    return {(m["era"], m["year"], m["month"], m["leap"]): i for i, m in enumerate(months)}


def _longest_ordered(days):
    """Indices of a longest non-decreasing run in `days` (None = no candidate)."""
    idx = [i for i, d in enumerate(days) if d is not None]
    best, prev = {}, {}
    for a in idx:
        best[a], prev[a] = 1, None
        for b in idx:
            if b >= a:
                break
            if days[b] <= days[a] and best[b] + 1 > best[a]:
                best[a], prev[a] = best[b] + 1, b
    if not idx:
        return set()
    end = max(idx, key=lambda i: (best[i], -i))
    keep = set()
    while end is not None:
        keep.add(end)
        end = prev[end]
    return keep


def date_records(records, months):
    mkey = month_index(months)
    year_end = {(m["era"], m["year"]): m["last_jdn"] for m in months}
    n = collections.Counter()
    shuo_rows = []
    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in records:
        r["jdn"], r["gregorian"], r["lunar_day"], r["precision"], r["date_from"] = None, "", None, "", ""
        r["flags"] = ""
        if r.get("month") is None:
            r["date_from"], r["flags"] = "none", "undated: before the first month header"
            n["undated"] += 1
        else:
            groups[mkey[(r["era"], r["year"], r["month"], r["leap"])]].append(r)

    for i in sorted(groups):
        M, recs = months[i], groups[i]
        first, last = M["first_jdn"], M["last_jdn"]
        cand, flags = [], [[] for _ in recs]
        for k, r in enumerate(recs):
            gz, d = r["gz"], None
            if gz:
                hits = [x for x in range(first - SLACK, last + SLACK + 1) if ganzhi.of_jdn(x) == gz]
                d = hits[0] if hits else None
            if r["header"] and r["shuo"]:                              # check A: the 朔
                cal = ganzhi.of_jdn(first)
                ok = gz == cal
                shuo_rows.append([r["rid"], r["juan"], r["header"], r["gz_as_read"], gz, cal, int(ok),
                                  "" if ok else (f"text's 朔 is {d - first:+d} day(s) from the calendar's"
                                                 if d is not None and abs(d - first) <= SLACK
                                                 else "not a day near the first of this month: probably misread")])
                n["shuo_agree" if ok else "shuo_differ"] += 1
                if not ok:
                    flags[k].append(f"朔 differs from calendar ({cal})")
                    if d is None or abs(d - first) > SLACK:
                        d = first                                      # a misread 干支: the header is still day 1
            cand.append(d)
        keep = _longest_ordered(cand)                                  # the chronicle only moves forward
        prev = None
        for k, r in enumerate(recs):
            gz, d = r["gz"], cand[k]
            fixed = bool(gz) and gz != r["gz_as_read"]
            if gz and (d is None or k not in keep):
                if fixed:
                    flags[k].append(f"{r['gz_as_read']} not taken as a date")
                    r["gz"] = ""
                    n["lookalike_not_a_date"] += 1
                    d = None
                else:
                    # A 干支 after a mark that is no day of the month, or breaks the order.
                    # If exactly one empty day between the dated records on either side
                    # differs from it by one character, the OCR misread that day: take it.
                    # Otherwise it is not a date (the author's ruling, 2026-11-10).
                    why = "is no day of this month" if d is None else "breaks the order of days"
                    nxt = min([cand[q] for q in range(k + 1, len(recs)) if q in keep and cand[q] is not None] + [last + 1])
                    lo = prev if prev is not None else first - 1
                    fits = [x for x in range(max(lo + 1, first), min(nxt, last + 1))
                            if (ganzhi.of_jdn(x)[0] == gz[0]) != (ganzhi.of_jdn(x)[1] == gz[1])]
                    if len(fits) == 1:
                        d = fits[0]
                        r["gz"] = ganzhi.of_jdn(d)
                        note = f"干支 corrected by the calendar: read {gz}, which {why}; {r['gz']} is the one empty day here that differs by one character"
                        if note not in r["notes"]:
                            r["notes"] = (r["notes"] + "; " if r["notes"] else "") + note
                        fixed = True
                        n["ganzhi_corrected_by_calendar"] += 1
                    else:
                        flags[k].append(f"干支 {gz} {why}: not taken as a date")
                        n["ganzhi_not_a_date"] += 1
                        d = None
            if d is not None:
                r["jdn"], r["precision"] = d, "day"
                r["date_from"] = "header" if r["header"] else ("restored" if r.get("restored") else "own")
                if not first <= d <= last:
                    flags[k].append("day lies just outside the calendar's month")
                if fixed:
                    flags[k].append(f"干支 read as {r['gz_as_read']}")
                prev = d
                n["dated_own"] += 1
            elif r["keyword"] == "是月":
                r["jdn"], r["precision"], r["date_from"] = last, "month", "是月"
                n["precision_month"] += 1
            elif r["keyword"] in ("是歲", "是年"):
                r["jdn"], r["precision"], r["date_from"] = year_end[(M["era"], M["year"])], "year", r["keyword"]
                n["precision_year"] += 1
            elif prev is not None:
                r["jdn"], r["precision"], r["date_from"] = prev, "day", "inherited"
                n["dated_inherited"] += 1
                if r["keyword"] == "先是":
                    flags[k].append("retrospective")
            else:
                r["date_from"] = "none"
                flags[k].append("no day yet in this month")
                n["undated"] += 1
            if r["jdn"] is not None:
                r["gregorian"] = reign_calendar.gregorian(r["jdn"])
                if r["precision"] == "day":
                    r["lunar_day"] = r["jdn"] - first + 1
            r["flags"] = "; ".join(flags[k])
            if flags[k]:
                n["records_flagged"] += 1
    return n, shuo_rows


def find_lost_dividers(records, months):
    """A 干支 inside a record that names a day in the empty gap after it.

    Between two records that carry their own day (A, then B), any day in between
    has no record.  If the text of the records in that stretch contains the 干支
    of such a day, a divider was probably lost there.  Certain =
      - it follows a blank (the lost mark left a gap), or
      - two or more such days follow in rising order, or
      - it is the day right after A, or the day right before B (the author's
        rules, 2026-11-10).  First version: both at once, a one-day hole between
        consecutive days.  Extended the same day: one side is enough, the days
        on the other side may be empty.  A 干支 with empty days on both sides
        still goes to a person.
    Everything else is a proposal for a person.
    """
    mkey = month_index(months)
    groups = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in records:
        if r.get("month") is not None:
            groups[mkey[(r["era"], r["year"], r["month"], r["leap"])]].append(r)
    out = []
    for i in sorted(groups):
        M, recs = months[i], groups[i]
        first, last = M["first_jdn"], M["last_jdn"]
        day_of = {ganzhi.of_jdn(d): d for d in range(first, last + 1)}
        anchors = [k for k, r in enumerate(recs) if r["date_from"] in ("own", "header", "restored")]
        for a, k in enumerate(anchors):
            A = recs[k]["jdn"]
            k2 = anchors[a + 1] if a + 1 < len(anchors) else len(recs)
            B = recs[k2]["jdn"] if k2 < len(recs) else last + 1
            if B - A <= 1:
                continue
            occ = []
            for kk in range(k, k2):
                t = recs[kk]["text"]
                for m in GZ.finditer(t):
                    if m.start() < len(recs[kk]["header"]) + 3 and recs[kk]["gz"] == m[0]:
                        continue                                       # the record's own day
                    d = day_of.get(m[0])
                    if d is None or not A < d < B:
                        continue
                    if t[m.end():m.end() + 1] in NOT_A_DAY_AFTER and t[m.end():m.end() + 1]:
                        continue
                    occ.append((kk, m.start(), d, t[m.start() - 1:m.start()].isspace() if m.start() else True))
            # longest strictly rising run, in reading order
            best = []
            for x in range(len(occ)):
                chain = [x]
                for y in range(x + 1, len(occ)):
                    if occ[y][2] > occ[chain[-1]][2]:
                        chain.append(y)
                if len(chain) > len(best):
                    best = chain
            for x in best:
                kk, pos, d, blank = occ[x]
                t = recs[kk]["text"]
                # consecutive days.  The day is the one right after the dated record
                # before it, or the one right before the next dated record (at the end of
                # a month: before the first day of the next month).  The days on its
                # other side may be empty.
                after_prev, before_next = d - A == 1, B - d == 1
                reasons = []
                if blank:
                    reasons.append("blank before the 干支")
                if len(best) >= 2:
                    reasons.append(f"run of {len(best)} rising days")
                if after_prev and before_next:
                    reasons.append("fills a one-day hole between consecutive days")
                elif after_prev:
                    reasons.append("the day right after the previous record's day")
                elif before_next:
                    reasons.append("the day right before the next record's day")
                out.append({"rid": recs[kk]["rid"], "pos": pos, "ganzhi": t[pos:pos + 2], "jdn": d,
                            "gregorian": reign_calendar.gregorian(d),
                            "certain": bool(reasons),
                            "why": "; ".join(reasons) or "single 干支, no blank",
                            "context": t[max(0, pos - 16):pos] + "【" + t[pos:pos + 2] + "】" + t[pos + 2:pos + 18]})
    return out


def apply_cuts(records, cuts):
    """Split records at the given (rid, pos).  The new record starts with the 干支."""
    by = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c in cuts:
        by[c["rid"]].append(c)
    out = []
    for r in records:
        if r["rid"] not in by:
            out.append(r)
            continue
        t = r["text"]
        points = sorted(by[r["rid"]], key=lambda c: c["pos"])
        head = dict(r)
        head["text"] = t[:points[0]["pos"]].rstrip()
        out.append(head)
        for q, c in enumerate(points):
            end = points[q + 1]["pos"] if q + 1 < len(points) else len(t)
            body = t[c["pos"]:end].rstrip()
            new = dict(r)
            new.update({"rid": f"{r['rid']}+{q + 1}", "mark": "", "header": "", "shuo": False,
                        "gz": c["ganzhi"], "gz_as_read": c["ganzhi"], "keyword": "", "text": body,
                        "restored": True,
                        "notes": (f"divider set by review; cut out of {r['rid']}" if c["why"] == "review" else
                                  f"divider restored from the calendar ({c['why']}); cut out of {r['rid']}")})
            out.append(new)
    return out

The old database (mingshilu.db, built from the old base text) is a second
witness, used only to check.  It dated its entries with its own code.

Run:  uv run 06_dates/check_days.py

import json
import pathlib
import sqlite3

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DB = HERE.parents[1] / "mingshilu.db"

old = {r[0] for r in sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB}?mode=ro", uri=True).execute(
    "select distinct jdn from v_entry where reign_id like '07%' and precision='day' and anchored=1")}
recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(HERE / "out" / "dated.jsonl", encoding="utf-8")]

restored = {r["jdn"] for r in recs if r["date_from"] == "restored"}
proposed = {int(r["jdn"]) for r in csv.DictReader(open(HERE / "out" / "dividers.csv", encoding="utf-8")) if r["status"] == "proposed"}
print(f"days with a record that carries its own 干支:  ours {len(ours)}, old database {len(old)}")
print(f"  in both {len(ours & old)};  only ours {len(ours - old)};  only old {len(old - ours)}")
print(f"restored dividers: {len(restored)} days, of which the old database also has {len(restored & old)}")
print(f"proposed dividers: {len(proposed)} days, of which the old database has {len(proposed & old)}")
